title: Implement PR Event Handler
description: Implement the handler for GitHub pull request events. Link pull requests to ticket IDs by parsing the PR title or branch name for ticket ID patterns (e.g., `[FORGEOS-BE028]` or branch `FORGEOS-BE028/feature`). Store the PR URL and status on the ticket record. Update ticket metadata when PRs are opened, merged, or closed.
acceptance_criteria: PR opened events extract ticket_id from PR title or branch name using regex
Ticket record updated with PR URL, PR number, and PR status (open, merged, closed)
PR merged events logged in the ticket's event history
PR closed without merge logged as a distinct event
Multiple PRs can be linked to the same ticket
Ticket IDs not found in the database produce a warning log but do not error
